The '''Warren''' was a region of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Taleucema]] on [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]]. The Warren was a slum that contained a number of poor individuals as well as a number of gangs, two of which were the [[Stoneskins]] and [[Yellow Thaelos]].<ref name="Mask of the Pirate Queen" />
